inferred_product_type.description: Product type used for template selection

evidence_volume.description: TC-983: Evidence volume metrics used for page scaling. Contains counts of claims, snippets, API symbols, workflows, and key features extracted from product_facts and snippet_catalog. Used by W4 to compute effective per-section quotas.

effective_quotas.description: TC-983: Effective per-section quotas after evidence scaling. Maps section names to their computed max_pages after applying tier coefficients and evidence-based targets. Used downstream by W7 for Gate 14 validation.

slug.description: Page slug (Round 13: enforced via Slug Sanitization Contract)

output_path.description: Content file path relative to site repo root

absolute_url.description: Absolute public URL for this page (e.g., https://docs.aspose.org/cells/overview/)

description.description: Brief description of page content and purpose for SEO and navigation

title.description: Page title (SEO recommended ≤70 chars; hard limit 120)

template_path.description: Path to template file for template-driven pages (blog)

cross_links.description: Absolute URLs to related pages on other subdomains (e.g., https://docs.aspose.org/cells/overview/). Format: https://<subdomain>/<family>/<slug>/

forbidden_topics.description: Topics/claims to explicitly avoid on this page

token_mappings.description: TC-964: Token mappings for template-driven pages (blog). Maps placeholder tokens to actual values for frontmatter and body content.

page_role.description: TC-971: Strategic role of page in content architecture. Defines page purpose and content boundaries. Optional in Phase 1 for backward compatibility.

content_strategy.description: TC-971: Content distribution and overlap prevention rules. Optional in Phase 1 for backward compatibility.

primary_focus.description: What this page is about (1-2 sentences)

forbidden_topics.description: Topics/concepts to explicitly avoid on this page

claim_quota.description: Minimum and maximum claims allowed on this page

child_pages.description: For TOC pages: slugs of child pages to list

scenario_coverage.description: For comprehensive_guide: 'all' means must cover all workflows from product_facts

avoid_overlap_with.description: Page slugs whose content this page should not duplicate

content_approach.description: Recommended approach for writing this page content

tone.description: Tone and style guidance for this page (e.g., instructional, reference, conversational)

unique_angle.description: Unique angle or value proposition differentiating this page from related ones

page_status.description: Round 12: Incremental page status. 'new'=first run, 'preserved'=reused from previous, 'updated'=regenerated, 'deleted'=removed.

related_pages.description: Round 12: Cross-page links from claim overlap detection. Top 3 pages with most overlapping claims.

overlap_score.description: Claim overlap score (Jaccard or weighted; observed values up to 2.25)

preservation_metadata.description: Round 12: Metadata for incremental page preservation decisions.

claim_overlap_score.description: Jaccard similarity of claim IDs between old and new page

should_preserve.description: Whether this page should be preserved (reuse previous content)

previous_run_id.description: Run ID of the previous run this page came from
